We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

_Do you want to lead complex development projects and bring people together to turn ambitious ideas into tangible results? Are you motivated by creating direction, driving progress, and making a visible impact across an international organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing complex development projects across functions and stakeholders through all project phases. The development projects can be electronic hardware, software, and/or services. By creating the right conditions and removing obstacles, you will enable project teams to succeed, while fostering collaboration, engagement, and ownership across the organization.

More specifically, you will be:

• Driving end-to-end project execution, including planning, governance, and follow-up

• Facilitating alignment between commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders

• Creating transparency on project progress, dependencies, and key decisions

• Ensuring the right balance between scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while managing risks and ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Challenging assumptions, priorities, and scope as well as facilitating difficult discussions and driving decision

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technology products in a highly collaborative and innovative environment. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across the business and have a significant impact on both individual projects and the way we collaborate across functions.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting directly to our Director of Project Execution, you will join the Project Execution department in Heat/Cooling. The team consists of 4 dedicated and experienced project managers with deep knowledge of both our business and organization. We bring experienced project leadership, structure, and transparency to complex development projects, helping turn ambition into successful execution. We foster a collaborative and open atmosphere, as we believe successful projects are built through collaboration, trust, accountability, and the courage to challenge existing ideas.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an experienced Project Manager with a proven track record of leading complex projects. You enjoy working with people from different professional backgrounds, while collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Have proven project management experience as well as an ability to deliver complex projects in a large organization

• Can establish trust, create alignment, and maintain momentum in projects that involve multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• Bring a constructive mindset and the ability to challenge existing ways of working

• Have a structured approach to work, allowing you to turn complexity into clarity

• Ideally have experience from product development, engineering, or other development environments

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. In this role, you will support our global demand planning for Point of Sale Materials (POSM), covering areas such as packaging, accessories, displays, sellable items and services.

Your role

As our Demand Planning Specialist, you will help develop accurate, reliable and insight-driven item-level forecasts aligned with our commercial, marketing and inventory objectives.

You will work closely with clusters and global teams, with particular focus on new launches and item transitions. Through strong analysis and collaboration, you will help us improve availability while managing inventory and reducing the risk of obsolescence.

In this role, you will:

Support and execute the global POSM demand planning process, ensuring forecasts are delivered according to agreed timelines and standards.

• 
Consolidate and validate forecasts across clusters, ensuring strong data quality and timely cross-functional input.

• 
Develop item-level forecasts across packaging, accessories, displays and sellable POSM.

• 
Maintain statistical baseline forecasts using demand history, market intelligence, marketing plans, sell-in signals and lifecycle changes.

• 
Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, identify key demand drivers and conduct root-cause analyses to recommend corrective actions.

• 
Translate planning and performance data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.

• 
Partner with Marketing, Clusters, Supply Planning and Procurement to build reliable forecasts for new launches and SKU transitions.

• 
Support phase-in and phase-out planning and proactively identify potential excess inventory, shortages and obsolescence risks.

• 
Work closely with clusters and global functions to align demand plans with commercial calendars, marketing campaigns, inventory targets and supply constraints.

• 
Contribute to improvements in planning processes, data and systems, helping strengthen planning quality, efficiency and inventory outcomes.

What we’re looking for

You are analytical and comfortable working with data, but equally confident turning numbers into a clear story for stakeholders. You enjoy collaborating across functions and markets, challenging assumptions constructively and taking ownership when something needs to move forward.

We imagine that you bring:

• 
1–3 years of relevant experience within Demand Planning, Supply Planning and/or Merchandise Planning.

• 
A relevant educational background in areas such as Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Finance & Economics or International Business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• 
Practical experience with forecasting, statistical modelling and root-cause analysis.

An understanding of end-to-end supply chain and inventory trade-offs.

• 
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• 
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across functions.

• 
A curious, proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint.

• 
Experience with Logility or a similar demand planning system, and/or Aptos or another allocation system.

• 
Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query or QlikView is considered an advantage.

Fluency in English.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be influencing the direction of our data platform and the way we build software, we imagine that you are solution-oriented and see opportunities where others see problems. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvement and constructively challenging existing approaches when needed. At the same time, you are motivated by helping others succeed and sharing your knowledge with fellow engineers.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

jobs.description:
Are you driven to transform cancer care by turning science into real-world change? In this role, you will connect cutting-edge evidence with clinical practice, helping physicians make well informed and confident decisions that improve outcomes for people living with cancer and those who care for them. Your work will accelerate the adoption of appropriate therapies by removing diagnostic and pathway bottlenecks through credible, balanced scientific engagement.

Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

As the therapy-area medical expert for your country, you will lead in-country scientific engagement and execute medical strategy with precision. You will collaborate closely with the Therapeutic Area Lead and country medical leadership, leveraging Nordic alignment to amplify impact. Using digital and AI-enabled tools to strengthen preparation, literature synthesis and insight capture—while upholding scientific integrity and compliance, you will turn external learning into action. Can you see yourself building trusted partnerships that shape launches and elevate standards of care?

This role is field based.

Accountabilities:

• Scientific Engagement: Develop and execute the country scientific engagement plan, building trusted relationships with experts, societies, investigators and healthcare stakeholders.

• Scientific Exchange: Lead balanced, non-promotional scientific dialogue, respond compliantly to unsolicited requests and manage advisory boards in line with procedures.

• Insight Generation: Identify pathway bottlenecks, diagnostic gaps and adoption barriers; translate insights into recommendations for strategy, evidence generation, launches and access.

• Launch & Transforming Care: Support launch readiness, medical education, scientific narrative development, objection handling and initiatives that address healthcare-system needs.

• Evidence & Clinical Trials: Identify local evidence gaps, support RWE and externally sponsored research, and contribute to clinical-trial feasibility, site engagement and delivery.

• Market Access Support: Provide scientific input to HTA, formulary and protocol submissions, guidelines and appropriate-use initiatives.

• Governance & Internal Enablement: Ensure compliance with local codes, SOPs and ethical standards; support medical review, pharmacovigilance and inspection readiness.

• Medical Expertise & Collaboration: Act as a therapy-area subject-matter expert, deliver scientific training and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and Nordic teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Advanced life-sciences degree, such as MSc, PharmD, MD or PhD.

• Proven deliverables for the experience in the relevant therapy area and scientific stakeholder engagement.

• Strong ability to generate insights, synthesize evidence and translate findings into action.

• Understanding of clinical trials, evidence generation and medical support for market access.

• Excellent scientific communication, influencing and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to use digital and AI-enabled tools with scientific rigor, compliance and sound judgment.

• Valid driver’s license as this is a field-based position.

• Fluency in the local language and English.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• PhD, MD, MBA or other relevant advanced qualifications.

• Proven successful pharmaceutical Medical Affairs experience, particularly in pre-launch or launch environments.

• Proven impactful collaborations in clinical trials, RWE or externally sponsored research.

• Experience supporting HTA, formulary or protocol submissions.

• Eligibility for local material certification.

• Proficiency with analytics, insight platforms and relevant management systems.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Why AstraZeneca

Join a team where science and strategy come together to change how cancer is treated. You will collaborate closely with clinicians, biostatisticians, data scientists, market access experts and more—often in the same room—turning evidence into practice that improves every step of the patient journey. We empower bold ideas, learn fast from what works, and back ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards. Our Philosophy

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused pharmaceutical company committed to excellence in the research, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines. At AstraZeneca, you'll have the chance to grow your abilities, skills and knowledge constantly in a place that never stands still. Discover why we're a great place to work and see what science — and you — can do.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important

**The Principal SaaS Solution Advisor plays a critical role in supporting the growth of SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offerings across new and existing client opportunities. Working closely with Sales, Account Management, and internal product and delivery teams, you act as a trusted advisor to prospects — guiding them through the strategic, commercial, and operational considerations of adopting a cloud-hosted, managed investment management platform.

Your focus is to shape and progress opportunities across the full presales lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution scoping through to RFP responses, tailored demonstrations, and competitive positioning. You bring both deep product fluency across SimCorp's evolving portfolio and genuine industry expertise, enabling you to engage credibly at the senior level and position SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offering as a compelling answer to the challenges reshaping the investment management industry.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Discovery & Scoping

**

• Engage prospects in structured discovery to understand their operating model, technology estate, regulatory environment, and strategic priorities.

• Translate functional and non-functional requirements into an indicative SaaS or SimCorp One solution scope, covering platform configuration, data services, connectivity, and managed service boundaries.

• Identify and document client-specific pain points and map them to SimCorp differentiators — including the SimCorp One open platform model, continuous delivery, and the reduced total cost of ownership relative to on-premise alternatives.

• Surface potential fit gaps early and provide structured feedback to Product and SaaS Operations.

**RFPs & Commercial Responses

**

• Lead or contribute to RFP responses for SaaS and SimCorp One opportunities, with focus on deployment model, service levels, data residency, security posture, and total cost of ownership.

• Articulate the SaaS and SimCorp One commercial model clearly — subscription structure, included services, upgrade inclusion, and open ecosystem positioning — in a way that resonates with procurement, finance, and technology stakeholders.

• Build and maintain a knowledge base of SaaS and SimCorp One RFP responses, keeping content current and aligned with contractual and operational commitments.

**Workshops, Scoping & Solution Validation

**

• Plan and deliver tailored workshops, scoping sessions, and architecture design discussions that help prospects understand the SimCorp One SaaS operating model, deployment approach, and managed service boundaries.

• Prepare and present compelling service descriptions, solution presentations, and platform overviews — adapting content and depth to the audience, from operational teams to C-level stakeholders.

• Design and facilitate workshops covering topics such as the shared responsibility model, release management, environment strategy, and the SimCorp One partner and data ecosystem.

• Where appropriate, support Solution Validation engagements, defining scope and success criteria aligned to the prospect's decision framework.

**SimCorp One & SaaS Proposition

**

• Develop and maintain deep knowledge of SimCorp One — its open platform architecture, API-first design, partner integrations, and the strategic direction of moving clients from on-premise deployments toward a composable, cloud-native operating model.

• Articulate clearly how SimCorp One differs from traditional SaaS delivery: the ability to connect third-party solutions, consume data services, and operate within a broader fintech ecosystem while retaining SimCorp Dimension as the investment book of record.

• Engage confidently with CTO, COO, and CIO-level stakeholders on cloud strategy, platform extensibility, vendor dependency, and the long-term operating model implications of the SimCorp One platform.

• Understand and articulate the value of SimCorp One Neo — SimCorp's embedded AI layer — including its agentic workflows, prompt library, and human-in-the-loop design, and position these capabilities as part of the broader SaaS and SimCorp One value proposition in client conversations.

**How You Contribute To The Team

**

• Partner closely with Sales Specialists and Account Management to ensure consistent and compelling messaging to prospects and business partners.

• Provide feedback on competitive positioning and product gaps based on prospect and market insights.

• Coordinate with broader presales and delivery colleagues to ensure continuity and quality across the opportunity lifecycle.

• Contribute to the ongoing improvement of SaaS and SimCorp One Solution Advisory tooling, decks and material.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you see yourself thriving in the role described above. How you acquired the relevant skills matters less than your ability and willingness to apply them and continue learning.

Ideally, you bring experience in several of the following areas:

• A minimum of 7 years’ experience in investment management technology, in a presales, solution advisory, or senior implementation capacity.

• Deep understanding of buy-side operating models across asset managers, asset owners, insurance companies, or wealth managers — including front-to-back investment workflows, data management, and the pressures driving technology transformation.

• Fluency in industry trends such as fee compression, the shift to alternatives, T+1 settlement, cloud adoption, and evolving regulatory frameworks (e.g. DORA, AIFMD, MiFID).

• Strong knowledge of SimCorp Dimension, SimCorp One, or competing front-to-back investment management platforms.

• Solid grounding in enterprise and solution architecture — able to engage credibly with client architects, CTOs, and IT leadership on integration patterns, data design, and platform decisions, and to translate technical complexity into clear business value narratives.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment models, including public cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP), hybrid and private cloud strategies, and the considerations financial services firms face around cloud adoption, data residency, and operational resilience.

• Understanding of the broader investment technology stack — including APIs and event-driven integration, data and analytics platforms, reference and market data management, and how these components interact within a modern front-to-back architecture.

• Experience operating in complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder sales environments.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging from operational to C-level audiences.

• Proficiency in PowerPoint and standard sales tooling.

• Comfort working with AI tools and a demonstrated ability to adopt and apply emerging technologies and methods — translating new capabilities into practical value in a client-facing context.

• Language skills: English required; additional European languages are advantageous.

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

• Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.

Apply Now

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

**Job Description

**In Credit Risk Model Validation (CRMV), we are reimagining model risk management across Danske Bank, moving from manual data wrangling, ad hoc scripts, and copied notebooks towards an industrialised, reproducible, AI-accelerated quantitative engineering ecosystem.

To realise this vision, we are looking for a Senior Model Validation Quant who bridges quantitative model validation and software and infrastructure engineering. You will combine strong quantitative skills with sound engineering practices to validate models, build our core validation software, and configure modern cloud workflows.

Enabling the team to perform high-quality, repeatable validations is as important as running them yourself. Your initial focus will be roughly 70% direct model validation and 30% tooling and infrastructure engineering, adapting as our platform and automation mature.

You will join a skilled, collaborative, forward-thinking team of risk professionals migrating to GitHub Enterprise Cloud and Databricks, building modular internal Python packages, configuring Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, and using GitHub Copilot as a daily engineering partner.

**What you will be doing:

**

• Perform and lead model validations: independently validate credit risk models (e.g. PD, LGD, CF, and IFRS 9), assessing conceptual soundness, statistical performance, and model limitations.

• Build and evolve validation software: design, implement, and maintain core Python packages and shared libraries that translate quantitative methodologies into clean, parameter-driven, testable tools.

• Enable the department: create tools and automated templates that help fellow validators run analyses, generate standard evidence bundles, and produce publication-ready PDF reports with minimal manual effort.

• Design modern workflows and infrastructure: set up and manage GitHub Actions workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for automated, audit-ready execution across environments.

• Integrate AI-assisted engineering: use GitHub Copilot extensively each day to accelerate code delivery, write comprehensive test suites, and modernise legacy codebases.

• Promote engineering excellence: promote sound version control practices, structured code reviews, and reproducible analyses across the team.

• Engage key stakeholders: clearly and persuasively present technical architectures, quantitative findings, and validation conclusions to model developers, risk leaders, and regulatory counterparts.

**About you:

**

• Quantitative grounding: you have an MSc or PhD, or equivalent practical experience, in a quantitative discipline (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, quantitative finance, data science, or engineering).

• Strong coding practices: you have solid practical experience writing clean, modular Python and SQL code.

• Collaborative version control (Git is essential): you are confident with Git branching strategies, pull requests, automated checks, and collaborative code reviews.

• Infrastructure and automation mindset: you have practical experience with, or a strong interest in learning, platforms such as Databricks (including DABs) and GitHub Actions.

• Enthusiasm for AI tooling: you are keen to use GitHub Copilot daily to enhance your workflow. Prior experience is a plus, but curiosity and openness to AI-assisted coding matter most.

• Bridge-builder mindset: you enjoy combining quantitative modelling with software engineering and switching between building infrastructure and exploring model mechanics.

• Clear communicator: you communicate clearly and warmly in English, translating technical and mathematical nuances into accessible insights for colleagues with varied backgrounds.

**What we offer you:

**This position can be located both in Denmark and Lithuania. If the position is located in Lithuania, the salary range will be from 3280 EUR to 4920 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job) and your contractual job title will be Risk Methodology & Model Validation.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**Does this sound like the opportunity you have been looking for? We would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, please contact Morten Gadegaard Jørgensen mojrg@danskebank.dk

Technical Proficiencies:

• Microsoft security stack: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, M365 security, Defender (EDR), and ideally Sentinel or a comparable SIEM.

• Hardening baselines (CIS), patch management, and vulnerability scanning.

• Network security: Firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, and traffic monitoring.

• Scripting and automation with PowerShell.

• Incident response, triage, and log analysis.

Standards & Compliance: Solid working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2 requirements; awareness of OT / IEC 62443 is a strong plus.

Education & Certifications: Degree in IT/cybersecurity or equivalent proven experience. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft SC-200/AZ-500/SC-100, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH) are an advantage.

What We Offer

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is seeking an Experimental Technician for a permanent position, starting on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position will focus on field-grown vegetables and pulses.

Start date and duration
1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a permanent position on 32 hours per week. 

Job description

• 
Day-to-day care and maintenance of field trials involving vegetable crops and other annual crops

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, storage and recording of field-grown crops

• 
Planning and carrying out field trials

• 
General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables and fruit

• 
Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Your profile

• 
Day-to-day maintenance of areas used for agricultural crops outside experimental trials, as well as trials involving annual crops and fruit and berry species

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, handling and storage of field-grown crops

• 
Handling soil samples

Necessary certificates for operating the machinery available at AU-Auning for relevant field tasks

General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables

Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Who we are
The Department of Food Science is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. Its research covers a wide range of areas, including horticulture, fruit and vegetables, food quality and biochemistry, as well as sensory science and consumer science.

The department has approximately 60 full-time research staff, 70 PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, and 30 visiting students and researchers.

Most of the department's staff are based at Agro Food Park 48 in Skejby. Field trials involving outdoor crop production are carried out at AU Auning, near Gl. Estrup on the Djursland peninsula, where the team comprises five permanent staff members and two seasonal employees.

The department is characterised by openness, equality, dialogue and a strong sense of community. We consider these values an important part of the department's strategy and working environment.

Find out more about the Department of Food Science at www.food.au.dk.

What we offer

• 
A varied range of tasks in the field, orchard, workrooms and machinery shed

• 
An exciting workplace as part of a young, dedicated team

• 
Tasks tailored to your skills and competencies

• 
The opportunity to learn a great deal about vegetable production

• 
An insight into the world of research

• 
The opportunity to develop skills in planning and carrying out field trials

• 
A workplace in beautiful natural surroundings

• 
A workplace where employees are at the heart of everything we do

• 
Freedom and responsibility

• 
A job that contributes to the green transition

Place of work and area of employment
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the duty station is the AU-Auning Field Research Station, Department of Food Science, Gl. Estrup, Randersvej 8 H, 8963 Auning, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Assoc. Prof. Antonios Petridis, tel.: 20 63 36 82, email: apetridis@food.au.dk

Applications must be received no later than 25 November 2026.

The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.
